note: Soft-evidence rule base. Superset of data/rules.json (frozen, 92 clauses, bench-v2). G1 = v2 limits as strong soft evidence; G2 typicality matrix; G3 combinations; G4 visible manufacturing signatures (28 new perception features, need one VLM pass); G5 fiber architecture. Every v3 rule is a draft to verify.

undercut_present.question: Does this part have an undercut: a feature that would lock it inside a rigid one-piece mold, such as an internal lip, side hole, or reentrant snap feature? Surface recesses that release along the demolding direction do not count. Answer yes or no.

hollow.question: Is this part a CLOSED hollow body: an enclosed vessel, tank, duct, or container whose interior is sealed or nearly sealed (like a bottle or fuel tank)? Open trays, shells, panels with recesses, and open-backed housings are NOT closed hollow bodies. Answer yes or no.

constant_cross_section.question: Does this part have one constant cross-section along its whole length, like an extruded beam, channel, or tube of uniform profile? Answer yes or no.

axisymmetric.question: Is this part a body of revolution, rotationally symmetric about one axis like a cylinder, cone, or tank? Answer yes or no.

max_dimension_mm.question: Estimate the largest overall dimension of the part (its longest bounding-box edge) in millimetres.

production_volume.question: Classify the production volume this part was made for: answer 0 for a one-off prototype, 1 for low-volume production, 2 for high-volume mass production.

continuous_fiber_required.question: Does this part structurally require continuous (unbroken, oriented) fiber reinforcement, as opposed to short chopped fiber or unreinforced plastic? Answer yes or no.

sig_ejector_pin_marks.question: Look at any back, inner or hidden surface. Do you see small flat circular marks (roughly 3-10 mm across), often several in a row, left by the ejector pins of an injection mold? Answer yes or no.
sig_ejector_pin_marks.status: needs perception pass (not in the bench-v2 cache)
